cases.text: Alex's sent message: I committed to attend the Lisbon conference. I will finish arranging the trip this weekend: book the flight, reserve the hotel, buy the conference ticket, arrange transport from the airport, and send my dietary needs to the organizer. I haven't started those arrangements.
Alex's sent message to his coach: I am committing to make next week's meal plan on Sunday and send it to you. This is my specific promise for this week.

Notes. Weekly Review Template. Reflection: What went well? What could improve? Checklist: Fill calendar for next week. Make meal plan. Clear Quick Notes. Last edited six months ago. Alex opens this reusable template.

Build service message addressed to Alex: The release CI has failed because your signing certificate expired. Only you can renew it. Alex's sent reply: I will renew the certificate tomorrow; the release is waiting for me. No one is handling the renewal.
Alex's sent message: I recorded the intro video for my Northstar application. I still need the two references to agree and need to submit the application afterward. I will ask them tomorrow.

existing.title: Complete Northstar application
existing.description: Record the video, obtain reference permission, and submit the application.

cases.text: Team chat. Priya: I will send the budget proposal tomorrow. Omar: Great, I will review it on Friday. Alex is reading the conversation, but neither message is addressed to Alex.
Alex's saved commitments: Apply for the engineering position at Aurora by Friday. Separately, send Aurora the overdue invoice for my freelance project tomorrow. Both are still outstanding.

Coding session. User: Fix the login bug. Assistant: Implementation is done, running checks now. Validation plan: typecheck, lint, simulator startup, screenshot comparison. Current tool: pnpm test. User has not requested separate reminders.
